metaTitle: Custom Kraft Personal Care Items | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom kraft personal care items for eco-friendly bulk orders. Perfect for branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Kraft personal care items offer a natural, eco-conscious look that stands out from standard plastic packaging. The brown kraft finish pairs well with simple one-color logos for a rustic, artisanal feel. Ideal for tradeshows, employee wellness kits, or retail displays, these items include lip balms, hand sanitizers, and lotion tubes. Decorate with screen printing or foil stamping for a clean, minimalist brand impression.
heroAltText: Bulk custom kraft personal care items with natural brown packaging and logo imprint
